metaDescription: Keep the needs and wishes of the people you travel with, and use them again in your next plan.
title: Saved profiles
subtitle: The people who often travel with you, with everything they need. When you plan a new trip, just pick them instead of filling it all in again.

empty.title: No saved profiles yet
empty.body: Save the people who often travel with you just once. Their needs and wishes fill in by themselves every time you plan a trip.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.body: Try another word, or look at all profiles again.

suggestions.title: From your trips
suggestions.body: They have been on a trip with you. Save their profile so they are easy to pick again.

editor.name: Name or nickname
editor.nameMissing: Write their name or nickname first.
editor.notesPlaceholder: e.g. gets carsick on winding roads, brings their own medicine.
editor.notesHint: Notes are stored encrypted and only you can see them.

errors.full: You already have {count} saved profiles. Delete one to add a new one.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet, then try again.
errors.failed: The profile was not saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.deleteFailed: The profile was not deleted. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.loadFailed: Saved profiles couldn't load. Check your connection, then try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}'s profile?
deleteDialog.body: Their needs, allergies, and notes are deleted too. Trip plans you already made stay as they are.

picker.title: Pick from saved profiles
picker.empty: No saved profiles yet. Save the people who often travel with you on the saved profiles page.
